learning_outcomes.text: The engineer will frequently have to participate in structural decisions (investments, reorganization, new products, ...) and management decisions (decisions regarding purchasing, production, maintenance, project follow-up, storage and distribution, ...).
Have a general understanding of opportunities arising within business operations.
Possess knowledge regarding internal and external business economic reporting as well as business organizational structures (knowing).
Understand and apply a number of business economic calculation methods and organizational techniques (knowing + applying).
Be able to reproduce and interpret basic concepts, relationships, and structures in new business situations.
Be able to apply methods and techniques insightfully to solve new problems.
Be oriented towards the business economic and organizational interpretation of business events.
Analyze a certain situation or problem in terms of business and production organization, list shortcomings, formulate solutions with pros and cons, and propose them.
Be able to see the coherence between the different chapters.
Apply the theory learned in the OLA (Education Learning Activity) to different business situations.
Analyze what the problem is and then apply the correct technique to solve the problem. The solution can be reached through calculations or by writing a proposal for improvement.
Understand what a company is (classifications of economic aspects, activities, legal).
Understand business plan (mission, objectives, strategic planning).
Understand business economic aspects: General accounting, Financial analysis and financing, Costing systems, Investments, Budgeting and cash planning.

assessment_methods.method: Exam during the examination period (written, multiple-choice questions)

assessment_rules: For the multiple-choice exam, a penalty for incorrect answers will be applied. Students with a non-Dutch mother tongue may use a non-technical translating dictionary during evaluations if they prove their need to the ombudsman by specific deadlines (Dec 1, April 1, July 15). The student must present their permission at the start of the exam.
